notes: rk-nsex Tier A repair wave, LANDING-BLOCKER BL3, the ORIGIN half: 'a proved-mod-audit shard without a record or citation produces no finding at all.' rk cannot mechanically tell a literature PMA claim (which must join to an extraction record) from the campaign's own proof-mod-audit (which has no record to join to), and the pre-repair code resolved that by checking neither — inferring 'campaign' from silence, which is exactly how a literature claim passes with no citation at all. The repair does not invent a proxy: under `records: "required"` the campaign must SAY which it is, in one frontmatter field, and an undeclared or unrecognized `origin:` is an ERROR rather than a guess. Note the denominator: `0/0 shard-record joins`, correctly — until the shard declares itself a literature claim it is not yet in the join population, and the finding is precisely that it has not declared. `aism_behavior: n/a`. Mutation-proof: treating an undeclared origin as `campaign` returns this tree to zero findings, exit 0 — the pre-repair silence; observed and reverted. An invalid origin value (`origin: folklore`) is pinned in test/gates/refs-card-join.test.ts rather than a second tree.
